assertions.assertion: Program.cs removes or replaces at least one static AddOpenIdConnect registration with dynamic provider configuration
assertions.rationale: The static AddOpenIdConnect("EntraId", ...) is removed and replaced with AddConfigurationStore-backed dynamic providers, explicitly noted in a comment.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs or a seed file creates an OidcProvider with Scheme set to 'demoidsrv' and Authority set to 'https://demo.duendesoftware.com'
assertions.rationale: SeedData adds an OidcProvider with Scheme = "demoidsrv", Authority = "https://demo.duendesoftware.com", and ClientId = "login".

assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddConfigurationStoreCache() for caching dynamic provider lookups
assertions.rationale: The builder chain calls .AddConfigurationStoreCache() after AddConfigurationStore.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions or acknowledges that dynamic identity providers require the Enterprise Edition
assertions.rationale: An explicit edition note states dynamic identity providers are a Duende IdentityServer Enterprise Edition feature.
